highlight_subsections.heading: PagedAttention KV Cache Engine
highlight_subsections.summary: **PagedAttention KV Cache Engine**: Introduces operating-system-inspired virtual memory paging for attention Keys and Values, eliminating contiguous tensor fragmentation and unlocking up to 24x higher serving throughput (#1).

highlight_subsections.heading: Continuous Iteration-Level Batching
highlight_subsections.summary: **Continuous Iteration-Level Batching**: Dynamically inserts new requests and frees finished sequences at every token step rather than waiting for an entire static batch to complete (#2).

highlight_subsections.heading: OpenAI-Compatible Serving API & AsyncLLMEngine
highlight_subsections.summary: **OpenAI-Compatible Serving API & AsyncLLMEngine**: Drop-in `/v1/completions` and `/v1/chat/completions` HTTP server with token streaming and tensor-parallel multi-GPU execution (#3).
